narrative.title: The Tape Library Circulation Desk
narrative.scenario: An archive circulates a fixed number of tapes. Every checkout or re-shelve makes a tape the freshest item; when the shelves are full and a new tape arrives, the least recently requested one is pulled from circulation. Readers want instant answers: is a tape on the shelf, and what is its catalog number?
narrative.inputFormat: A capacity integer and a list of operations: ["put", key, value] or ["get", key].
narrative.outputFormat: Return the list of values produced by every get operation, in order; a miss returns -1.
constraints: At most 2 * 10^4 calls total; each must run in O(1)

testCases.explanation: Putting 3 evicts the stale key 2; putting 4 evicts key 1 since reading it made 3 fresher.
A capacity-1 cache forgets the old key the moment a new one arrives.

hintLevels: Level 1: Two questions per operation — where is the key, and who becomes the eviction victim?
Level 2: A hash map answers the first in O(1); a recency-ordered list answers the second.
Level 3: Reads must refresh recency too — forgetting that in get() is the classic bug this problem hunts.
